import numpy as np

# Extract the relevant columns for analysis
education_expenditure = adjusted_savings_df.iloc[:, 2:].values
school_primary_enrollment = school_primary_df.iloc[:, 2:].values
school_secondary_enrollment = school_secondary_df.iloc[:, 2:].values

# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and school enrollment
correlation_primary = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, school_primary_enrollment)
correlation_secondary = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, school_secondary_enrollment)

correlation_primary, correlation_secondary

# Extract the relevant columns for analysis
education_expenditure = adjusted_savings_df.iloc[:, 2:].values
exports_growth = exports_df.iloc[:, 2:].values
gni_per_capita = gni_df.iloc[:, 2:].values

# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and economic output
correlation_exports = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, exports_growth)
correlation_gni = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, gni_per_capita)

correlation_exports, correlation_gni

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Prepare the data for regression analysis
# For education expenditure and school enrollment
X_primary = school_primary_enrollment
y_primary = education_expenditure

X_secondary = school_secondary_enrollment
y_secondary = education_expenditure

# For education expenditure and economic output
X_exports = exports_growth
y_exports = education_expenditure

X_gni = gni_per_capita
y_gni = education_expenditure

# Perform regression analysis
model_primary = LinearRegression()
model_primary.fit(X_primary, y_primary)
coefficient_primary = model_primary.coef_

model_secondary = LinearRegression()
model_secondary.fit(X_secondary, y_secondary)
coefficient_secondary = model_secondary.coef_

model_exports = LinearRegression()
model_exports.fit(X_exports, y_exports)
coefficient_exports = model_exports.coef_

model_gni = LinearRegression()
model_gni.fit(X_gni, y_gni)
coefficient_gni = model_gni.coef_

coefficient_primary, coefficient_secondary, coefficient_exports, coefficient_gni
